notes.title: Version 1.5.43
notes.content:
We are pushing out this most recent update to address various reported issues as well as improve the overall experience for both new and returning players!

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
- Adjusted inventory so it will now always select the last item the player was hovering over when opened
- Adjusted elevator in all episodes so it will now default selection to match the floor the player is on

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Added a SYNC button to achievements screen which will ensure the local achievements and the platform achievements match
- Adjusted save system to ensure steam cloud saves now contain all progression instead of having some of it exist in the player's Registry
- Adjusted Quality settings so that VSYNC is now always forced on and additionally added a cap to FPS in cases where the player disable it, these will both ensure the game does not run at very high FPS on high powered machines

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Possible fix for issue where Sal's walk animation would not play correctly
- Fixed issue where players could open/close the pause menu during certain actions
- This corrects issue where during episode 4 [spoiler]players could swap Sal and Larry's position or potentially softlock themselves [/spoiler]
- Fixed issue where the game would not properly recognize when the DLC was not installed
- Fixed issue in episode 5 where  [spoiler]3D Sal's arm was not displaying properly [/spoiler]
- Fixed translation issue at the start of episode 1 where [spoiler]the gravestone text could sometimes have overlapping text[/spoiler]

If you experience any issues, please report them by either posting in the Steam discussions, the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/dzdBCCX]Sally Face Discord[/url], or by emailing me directly at mike@portablemoose.com and I'll get back to you as soon as I can.

Thanks and enjoy!
- Michael Thomas

notes.title: Testing Patch 1.5.43

Hello, everyone! 

For those that missed the announcement, Portable Moose has made its first hire! [b]Mike Thomas[/b] has joined me to help with programming and engine stuff. You'll see him on here as LoneWolf155 and can reach out directly for tech related issues at mike@portablemoose.com. In addition to assisting on other games (Sally Face 2 👀) he's been fixing up some things in Sally Face that I wasn't able to on my own. 

We've made a new public branch that we'd like to test a bunch of fixes on before pushing it to default branch. We've tested the game ourselves but would love to get some more feedback from anyone willing to play on this branch to help us find any potential issues the changes may have caused. Any help with testing on Mac and Linux is especially useful. The new branch is called "experimental" and you can access it by right clicking on the game in your Library, selecting Properties, then Betas, and changing the branch via the dropdown. Once we know the build is solid, then we'll release it on the default branch. 

Reply to this thread with any feedback regarding this new build. 

Thank you! 
💙 Steve

notes.title: Steve's 2024 Recap
notes.content:
2024 was a year of transitions, as I wrapped up several big projects and settled into my new home.

[h1]FINISHING UP PROJECTS[/h1]
There were a lot of files to review for Strange Nightmares to make sure everything was good for release. I received early samples of the game and the merch for review as well, and signed a bunch of stuff for the Kickstarter backers. The manufacturing phase took longer than expected so shipping got pushed to January, but it’s been great to finally see the products reaching fans and how happy they are. 

Check out the How to Play video I made for Strange Nightmares:
[previewyoutube=b5DYHXnIwE0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you missed out, here’s the store page for [url=https://maestromedia.com/collections/sally-face-strange-nightmares-pre-order]Strange Nightmares[/url] stuff:
[url=https://maestromedia.com/collections/sally-face-strange-nightmares-pre-order][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/30b725ab015fb9fab7d8f424b96bfb63ae988e9d.png[/img][/url]

I also finished the narrative and final art piece for Strange Boxes, which was a lot of fun to work on. I hope everyone who got the boxes enjoyed their time with them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/703a07f7a12ebe65172711fb19e252c800163817.png[/img]

Another big project that came to an end in 2024 was the Sally Face art book. The files were finalized earlier in the year and the book launched in October. If you haven’t gotten your hands on it yet, it came out awesome! Titan did a great job with it. You can grab a copy on [url=https://titanbooks.com/72080-sally-face-art-lore-and-more/]Titan’s site[/url] and it’s also on Amazon, Barnes and Noble, Walmart, Target, etc.
[url=https://titanbooks.com/72080-sally-face-art-lore-and-more/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/4ca35e8e11f3a2cba5e315e9916d1ee45d98ff73.jpg[/img][/url]

In previous years, I had been working on a pitch for a Sally Face animated series. We got as far as signing on with two big studios and pitching to the major networks. Unfortunately, despite a lot of interest from the networks, the timing just didn’t work out. But the high amount of interest left me hopeful. In fact, I’ve been working on a movie pitch that I think is shaping up to be something great. So fingers crossed we have better luck with that avenue!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/3875a009cec390005567065a94c668de406fd668.png[/img]

[h1]THE HOUSE OF HAMELIN[/h1]
With my other team, Wither Studios, we’ve been continuing work on The House of Hamelin – a deckbuilding roguelike game where you’re searching for your missing cat in the twisted halls of an ever changing house that’s filled with horrible creatures. This game has been a ton of fun to work on and is shaping up awesomely. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/e330a894665ea91aa76c3530ea416373022e9374.png[/img]

We demoed early builds of the game at the Phoenix Theater in Pittsburgh, at TORG in Columbus, at the Bit Bridge Halloween Showcase in Pittsburgh, and at Cleveland Gaming Classic – where we also won an award for “Best Art Design”. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/80ec0c71c1339a4cc9f4893a146301a154d0392b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/8e47350de939d97ccfcf5107e1c278c454227150.png[/img]

We’re aiming for an Early Access release sometime this year. No exact date yet but we’ll announce when we’re ready. In the meantime, wishlists are extremely helpful to securing a successful launch. So any [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233300/The_House_of_Hamelin/]wishlists[/url] are greatly appreciated!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233300/The_House_of_Hamelin/

[h1]PERSONAL STUFF[/h1]
As a personal update, I’ve been exploring alternate options besides surgery for the herniated discs in my neck but I haven’t found a good solution yet. I’ve also been having some other mysterious health issues that I’ve been getting a lot of tests on, but with no luck. I’m hopeful that things will improve, it’s just been a bit of a mental weight on me this past year. 

I’ve also had a lot of various household projects, with the new house. It seems like there’s always something to fix or work on, but that was to be expected. At least it’s usually rewarding work (I even replaced a full sink on my own and it works and everything!). It may have taken me until my late 30s to be able to afford my first home, but I’m proud of it and feel fortunate to have this nice spot to settle down in. 

Speaking of feeling fortunate, I was able to do the annual Halloween Road Trip with my good friends again and it was such a great time. We hit 6 haunted houses and 2 escape rooms in 3 days. I’m already looking forward to next Halloween!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/1f77716227822c5d3bd256d0817eba959fc5ebff.png[/img]

[h1]A NOTE ABOUT SF2[/h1]
I was able to get more done on Sally Face 2 in 2024. Though, progress has been slow with all of my other projects. So it’s going to be a little while still and I thank you all for your patience and understanding.  

I don’t like to give release estimates until I have a time frame I’m more confident with. If we look at the first game, it took about 8 years of development (2015-2019 for the episodes, 2020-2022 for console ports) and besides writing the script for SF2 while working on other projects, development didn’t really start until 2024. 

That said, I’m still planning to hire a couple people to help speed things up significantly. I know I’ve mentioned this before but I was too quick in bringing it up and wasn’t ready as soon as I thought I’d be. But I’ll definitely be putting the call out this year sometime. So if you’re interested, get those portfolios ready! Just please wait until I make the announcement for job openings before emailing me. 

[h1]SO MUCH MERCH[/h1]
If you’re itching for more Sally Face merch, here are some neat new things:

[url=https://youtooz.com/products/sally-face-plush-9-inch]YouTooz pre-order (today is the last day!)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/0e20a1fed3102990830d17696e3ed0cf34c444e5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/6afb80cae9f8e9b5e2f02c2c0890b3ee17d202e2.jpg[/img][/url][/url]

[url=https://www.spencersonline.com/product/sally-face-slippers/276080.uts]Sal Slippers
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/ca9b09a9e29b618b8422e814b94bbb2b7bacecc6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/f12c15045cba1575e9f7f2b9a88117571b806232.jpg[/img][/url][/url]

[url=https://www.spencersonline.com/product/sally-face-lounge-pants/266261.uts]Sally Face Pajama Pants
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/a7512f2052ae429d3abe18b3aa791174d0f4e452.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/b22365b1c6caf0e605718f5ee48b9187b553611c.jpg[/img][/url][/url]

[url=https://www.spencersonline.com/product/sally-face-checkered-crew-socks-/267256.uts]SF Socks
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/d788d93ffe8c0d6d5b3360d670c2a98099e5016d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/98a05fdc3c7550e348568d591d8ece2e1b49a588.jpg[/img][/url][/url]

[h1]BONUS LORE[/h1]
Back when we were doing the Kickstarter for Strange Nightmares (in 2023!), I released a few little Sally Face bonus lore bits. I came across these again recently and I thought it'd be nice to share them again for those who haven't seen them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/1ca2240d33ac87d42b348b423b632c912eb94bf6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/ea4774ec16148aecaadab6fcb2862f78e86c689a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/f3c625dd7e18b5572ebd04d947894d3e9fdebc68.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26717511/8dcdc793763657910453f98739c13704515b0604.png[/img]

[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]
Thank you all for continuing to support the world of Sally Face as it expands beyond what I could have ever imagined it would. It’s been a tough road, full of ups and downs, and at times, has felt very overwhelming. Yet, the fans have made this journey feel worth it.

Keep fighting the darkness

💙 Steve

notes.title: General Troubleshooting & FAQ
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! 

A quick note on reporting issues. If you are having any troubles, take a look at the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/541570/discussions/0/1471967615872768585/]Troubleshooting Thread[/url] for suggested actions. Please follow those steps before reporting an issue as this may save both of us time. If you're still having an issue, you can write on the discussion directly or email me at portablemoose@gmail.com but please don't report anywhere else. If you post issues in other places I may not see them and I want to make sure we can resolve any potential problems. 


Additionally, I've started an [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/541570/discussions/0/1471967615872857374/]FAQ Thread[/url] to help find answers to frequently asked questions. Feel free to ask more questions on that discussion as well. Just keep in mind that I won't answer anything involving spoilers.


Thank you for your continued support of Sally Face! 

- Steve
[url=https://twitter.com/PortableMoose]@PortableMoose[/url]
